body: Found by running the spike three times. With a fixed 900ms sleep the proof passed only 2 of 3; the failing run had tab B's first request leave before its DNR rule existed, so it rode the shared jar and landed already logged in — and isolation never recovers for that tab. Polling until getSessionRules() shows the rule made it 3/3. The product cannot poll from outside: it must create the tab parked on about:blank, install the rule, confirm it, then navigate. This race is the most likely single cause of the flakiness users report in shipped multi-session extensions.
title: Engine must own tab creation and await rule install before navigating
